title: Strange Omnipod DASH error code
symptom: While injecting a bolus with Omnipod DASH, a POD Fault: 49 error occurred. The pod beeped until deactivated. The user requested a bolus, the app seemed stuck, they killed the app and requested another bolus because they didn't receive notification that insulin was injected.
cause: The app crashed while a bolus was being delivered, and the user requested another bolus while the previous one was still being delivered, which may have caused the pod fault.
fix: Fixed with pull request #1211. The thread does not specify the exact fix details.
